title: Hermes six-tool deterministic preprocessing prototype

prior_run.evidence: Neither supports nor rejects Hermes; silent truncation, incorrect canaries, unamended representation

pre_amendment_observation: No model-training results or official evaluation results were observed before this amendment.
scope_note: This statement concerns exp_001b; the earlier synthetic Phase 1 optimizer smoke remains recorded.

source.attribution: publisher-attributed Kimi-K2.5/Hermes execution; not externally authenticated

subset.deduplication: Global exact ordered tuple of six (token-ID tuple, option-marker tuple) pairs in frozen tool order; retain first sorted (trajectory_id, message_index); SHA-256 of canonical JSON representation for audit only

representation.constructor: Import laya.common.build_sequence from verified repository-local pinned checkout; no local reimplementation

question.ins: Does the next assistant turn call the {tool} tool?

state_allowlist: reasoning-stripped immediately previous assistant call value
fixed six availability names and section headings
representation.fit_precheck: Tokenize complete upstream serialize_state(state).replace(tokenizer.mask_token, ' ') with add_special_tokens=False and truncation=False. For EVERY question require state length <= 512 - len(upstream empty-state sequence). Only then call upstream on full state and assert IDs == empty[:-1] + full_state_ids + final_separator and markers unchanged.
representation.mask_sanitization: Upstream literal mask replacement is canonical; no additional lossy content truncation

target.upstream_options: Canonical noul false/true descriptions from render_options; index order false then true

split.group_proxy: lowercase whitespace-normalized task with numeric and quoted literals replaced
split.claim_limit: template-proxy-disjoint within-corpus only; not authenticated task-family or repository isolation

canaries.coverage: Every representable candidate before dedup; bytes and all six actual upstream inputs compared by deterministic assertions
canaries.target: Mutate source target turn content, calls, arguments, labels and auxiliary target fields, then project identical observable pre-target input
canaries.metadata: Mutate every excluded top-level field and add ID/category/subcategory/teacher/harness/split/provenance/row/shard/labels sentinels; retain task, tools eligibility and conversations; project through explicit allowlist
canaries.reasoning: Two source variants differ only inside a balanced think span in the previous call; both pass real structural stripping; rendered bytes and sequences must match each other and baseline
canaries.positive_control: Small fixture mutates observable prior response and must change bytes and tokens
canaries.malformed: Unmatched/nested reasoning rejects whole trajectory; zero residual markers required in retained states

fail_closed: New immutable execution directory; refuse reuse; write RUNNING status before checks, diagnostics on failure, PASS manifest only after all outputs/checksums complete. No model-ready split files on failed gates. Diagnostic retained-row manifest may include identity, labels and input hashes but no model inputs.
required_outputs: model-ready candidate rows without sealed-test model access (PASS only)
selection-bias tables by split, proxy group, category, and label
positive-row and positive-trajectory support by tool and split
stop_gates: any target or excluded-metadata canary reaches rendered tokens
any incomplete, nonadjacent, unparsable, count-mismatched, or name-mismatched retained call-result pair
any unavailable or malformed retained target label
any retained state exceeds 512 tokens or loses required content
any trajectory or proxy group crosses splits
any split has fewer than 10 positive trajectories for a retained tool
over-budget exclusion-rate absolute difference exceeds 10 percentage points between any two splits
over-budget exclusion-rate absolute difference exceeds 20 percentage points between positive and negative examples for any retained tool

interpretation.pass: converter and candidate subset are technically viable for subsequent protocol review
interpretation.fail: Hermes candidate is rejected or the subset/protocol must become a new explicit revision
